title: Law.com reports on Burford's hiring of Head of Korea amid rising demand for legal finance
summary: Law.com International covers Burford's hiring of Elizabeth Shin as Senior Vice President and Head of Korea as a response to rising demand for sophisticated legal finance in the Korean market. The article highlights Shin’s background in international arbitration and cross-border disputes and explores how Korea’s growing role in global patent and commercial matters is shaping Burford’s expansion strategy in Asia. Learn more.
body_markdown:
*Law.com International* covers Burford's hiring of[Elizabeth Shin](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/elizabeth-shin/) as Senior Vice President and Head of Korea as a response to rising demand for sophisticated legal finance in the Korean market. The article highlights Shin’s background in international arbitration and cross-border disputes and explores how Korea’s growing role in global patent and commercial matters is shaping Burford’s expansion strategy in Asia.


Read the article[here](https://www.law.com/international-edition/2026/01/21/litigation-funder-burford-capital-bets-on-korea-makes-first-hire-from-lee--ko/?slreturn=20260123114240?idxno=91758) .
